clusters.name: your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rose over money in March 1988 and she stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; your grandfather died in July 1989; your brother's grades fell by November 1989; and your mother's anxiety eased once she returned to work in March 1990. The shifts in these months form a cluster around the loss, with your mother's earlier worry about money and distance from your father standing beside your brother's drop in functioning after the death.

clusters.name: your mother Della's diagnosis of breast cancer, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your leaving home for college in September 1993 and your mother's diagnosis of breast cancer in February 1995: you developed migraines by March 1994 and called your brother most nights by April 1994; your mother was told she had breast cancer in February 1995; you stopped returning your brother's calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996. The shifts in these years form a cluster around your mother's serious illness, with your move away from home opening a period when your relationship moves toward and then away from your brother tracked alongside her diagnosis.
